headline: Besides expensive fuel this winter, bills to be reckoned with: up to 37% increases in Forlì-Cesena
summary: Household bills in Forlì-Cesena could increase by up to 37%, on top of expensive fuel this winter. The article warns that the continuing conflict situation could mean a costly autumn and winter for bills.
why: Energy costs affect household spending and inflation in Italy, and they feed into utility and fuel markets that investors monitor across Europe.

original_headline: Oltre al caro carburante in inverno si farà i conti con le bollette, a Forlì-Cesena rincari del 37%
